name: Open Babel
summary: Chemical file-format conversion and molecular preparation toolkit.

steps: Read the official installation guide and choose the current maintained binary or package-manager route for the user's operating system.
Review the release provenance and installation target before applying a Windows installer, Linux distribution package or macOS package; avoid changing system PATH without explicit approval.
Check the obabel CLI in the selected environment and separately validate any required file-format plugins and Python bindings.
install.verify_note: Run obabel -V or the maintainer's documented help command, then test a tiny format conversion separately.

notes: The official binary instructions vary by platform. Python bindings and plugins are not guaranteed by the CLI installation.
